purpose: A non-pending outer throw forwards to the used-yield leaf; its array-owned buffered payload is released before the same supplied Exception is caught, while a separate raw reference cache and copied rows retain their own lifetimes.
source:
<?php
class ReviewBufferedOld20 { function __destruct() { echo "A|"; } }
class ReviewBufferedNew20 { function __destruct() { echo "CACHE|"; } }
class ReviewBufferedPayload20 { function __destruct() { echo "B|"; } }
function &reviewBufferedLeaf20() { global $cache; try { echo "C|"; $received = yield $cache; echo "BAD-BODY|"; } catch (Exception $caught) { echo "CATCH|", $caught === $GLOBALS["exception"] ? 1 : 0, "|"; echo "LIVE|", $cache[0] instanceof ReviewBufferedNew20 ? 1 : 0, "|"; $tail = 13; yield $tail; echo "T|"; return 23; } finally { echo "J|"; } }
function reviewBufferedMiddle20() { try { echo "M|"; $answer = yield from $GLOBALS["child"]; echo "I|", $answer, "|"; return 29; } finally { echo "K|"; } }
function reviewBufferedOuter20() { try { echo "O|"; $answer = yield from $GLOBALS["middle"]; echo "F|", $answer, "|"; return 31; } finally { echo "Z|"; } }
$cache = [new ReviewBufferedOld20()]; $exception = new Exception("buffer20");
$child = reviewBufferedLeaf20(); $middle = reviewBufferedMiddle20(); $outer = reviewBufferedOuter20();
echo "P|"; $outer->rewind();
$row = $middle->send([new ReviewBufferedPayload20()]);
echo "S|", $row[0] instanceof ReviewBufferedOld20 ? "OLD|" : "BAD|";
$row[0] = null; unset($row); echo "W|";
$cache = [new ReviewBufferedNew20()]; echo "V|", $middle->current()[0] instanceof ReviewBufferedNew20 ? "LIVE|" : "BAD|";
$result = $outer->throw($exception); echo "THROW|", $result, "|"; unset($result);
$outer->next(); echo "RET|", $outer->getReturn(), "|";
unset($child, $middle, $outer, $cache, $exception); echo "E";

purpose: The buffered input aliases the yielded object. Releasing only the used-result slot leaves the raw current owner intact through catch; replacement by the catch yield releases that cache before the API returns.

<?php
class ReviewBufferedAlias20 { function __destruct() { echo "A|"; } }

function reviewBufferedAliasMiddle20() { try { echo "M|"; $answer = yield from $GLOBALS["child"]; echo "I|", $answer, "|"; return 29; } finally { echo "K|"; } }
function reviewBufferedAliasOuter20() { try { echo "O|"; $answer = yield from $GLOBALS["middle"]; echo "F|", $answer, "|"; return 31; } finally { echo "Z|"; } }
$exception = new Exception("alias20");
$child = reviewBufferedAliasLeaf20(); $middle = reviewBufferedAliasMiddle20(); $outer = reviewBufferedAliasOuter20();
echo "P|"; $outer->rewind();
